content.value: Design an isolated column footing of uniform thickness for an axially loaded column of 20 inch x 15 inch in size transmitting a load of 250 kips. The safe bearing capacity of soil is 2.0 ksf. Use $f _ { c } ^ { \prime } ~ = ~ 3 0 0 0$ psi and $f _ { y } = 6 0 0 0 0$ psi. Show the reinforcement details.
